{{Top|leg}}
The '''Beija Major Sea''' was the larger of the two [[Ocean/Legends|seas]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]. It covered nearly one fourth of [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali's]] surface. It was 10,000 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] across at its widest point.
